source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus path separators and file bytes, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

observations.result: State, contracts, architecture, distribution metadata, strict typecheck, 70 tests with 366 expectations, Electron compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health all pass; Fallow health is 87.8/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow moderate advisory and documented distribution warnings.
No issues in the 12 changed implementation, contract, fixture and test files for the reviewed-AI increment.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.

14 focused tests with 97 expectations pass, covering byte-preserving local drafts, per-file and per-hunk approval, stale revision rejection, recovery undo, organization scope, Canvas/Bases assistance, formula/code denial, IPC validation and the reviewed-AI journey entry points.
Main 108.75 KB, preload 4.22 KB and renderer 85.22 KB bundles compile with the reviewed-AI IPC broker and workspace panel.

implemented: Added a provider-neutral local drafting broker for append, prepend, replace/rewrite, outline and summarize instructions; unsupported free-form model drafting fails explicitly without a provider fallback.

Added per-file and per-hunk changesets with before/after bytes, BOM/line-ending preservation, approved-scope validation, preflight of every disk revision, journaled VaultStore writes, recoverable history and revision-checked undo.
Added a visible AI review panel and command-palette entry with provider destination none, untrusted-source warnings, explicit file/hunk approval, stale-edit save guards and recoverable undo.

Added scoped organization suggestions for unresolved links, missing properties, duplicate notes, user-chosen rename/move plans, Canvas text cards and read-only Bases views; arbitrary formula/code execution is denied.

Added shared IPC validators, preload/main broker handlers, journey and safety fixtures, prompt-injection/scope/denial tests and legacy-agent capability isolation through the existing plugin policy boundary.
limitations: This slice intentionally does not contact a provider; managed, BYOK and local endpoint/model selection, credentials, cancellation, usage caps and model lifecycle remain P4.3 work.

Organization, Canvas and Bases suggestions are preview/read-only plans; applying an actual organization rename or structural Canvas/Bases model change still requires a separate explicit safe changeset boundary.
The local Electron binary is unavailable, so visible desktop AI review, accessibility-tree, cross-platform and reference-Obsidian round-trip runs remain external-pending.
